case_number: 2024 INSC 601; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO………. OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No.9783/2023)
summary: Appeal against High Court direction to file complaint under IPC s.193 for allegedly false affidavit during bail cancellation proceedings; denial of allegations not per se false evidence under IPC s.191-193; constitutional bench precedent (Iqbal Singh Marwah) requires judicial discretion in filing complaint under CrPC s.195(1)(b); Court not bound to initiate perjury proceedings merely due to contradictory affidavits; direction set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; direction to file complaint under IPC s.193 set aside; perjury complaint quashed.
